$note: Knob contract for the Vertical clean-slide (film advance), recorded 1:1 from apps/quadro/public/slide-lab/vs3-parallax-depth-layers.html. The TWO load-bearing knobs are pitchVh and frameH: their difference is the zero-overlap guarantee. pitchVh (JS, == CSS --pitch/100vh) MUST equal the CSS --pitch, and PITCH - frameH MUST stay > 100vh (one viewport) after the climax growth + parallax worst case. Do NOT change pitch/frameH without re-proving the gap (200 - 76 = 124vh; worst case at climax 96.4vh < 124vh => still >100vh clear).

pitchVh.meaning: PITCH = slide height = centre-to-centre travel per step, in viewport-heights. JS pitchPx() = innerHeight * pitchVh and MUST equal the CSS --pitch (200vh => 2.00). The whole zero-overlap proof rests on PITCH - frameH > 1 viewport.

frameH.meaning: The render photo's height, centred in its slide (CSS --frameH). The clear void GAP = (pitchVh*100 - frameH). At defaults 200 - 76 = 124vh > 100vh, with 24vh margin per side. Raising frameH or lowering pitch shrinks the void — re-prove >100vh.

climaxFrameH.meaning: The climax slide's grown frame height at full --peak. Capped so grown frame (94vh) + image lag (<=2.4vh) = 96.4vh stays under the 124vh void budget (>100vh clear at peak). Growth is gated to the stationary HOLD.

move.meaning: MOVE — the timeline fraction spent translating the track at constant velocity (pure linear scrub on ONE property). The remaining (1 - move) is the climax HOLD where the track is stationary and --peak ramps 0->1.

scrub.meaning: ScrollTrigger scrub on the single pinned timeline — SMOOTHING ONLY, not snap. The clean-slide intentionally has NO snap: motion is one constant-velocity linear tween so it reverses exactly.

endMult.meaning: Pin length: ScrollTrigger end = (N-1) * innerHeight * endMult. Sets how much scroll one full top-to-terrace advance costs (and thus the dwell per cel).

climaxIndex.meaning: Which slide holds the climax (the .is-climax slide). Recorded as the LAST slide (terrace-04). Its leg end is forced to 1 so it keeps breathing through the HOLD while --peak grows the frame.

kenBurns.meaning: Per-slide ken-burns: --kb eases from kb0 (incoming) to kb1 over the slide's leg (ease sine.inOut), settling the photo as the frame lands. transform-origin set per slide (m.origin).

parImg.meaning: DEEP plane rate: the image (--par) lags the frame, easing from +par (incoming) THROUGH 0 (centre) to -par (exit). BOUNDED |par| <= 2.4vh and clipped inside .frame (overflow:hidden) so it can never escape the frame box or break the void budget.

parCap.meaning: NEAR plane rate: the caption (--capPar) LEADS the frame (closer to the lens), mirroring the image with opposite sign. BOUNDED |cap| <= 1.6vh; the caption is atomic inside its slide so it never leaves the frame.

parBrk.meaning: VOID ordinal rate: the chapter ordinal in the gap (--brkPar) parallaxes OPPOSITE the rise, so the void between cels reads as depth between film planes. The void (not a photo) is the only thing on screen at the mid-step.

settle.meaning: MASTER plane scale-settle: the frame (--settle) goes 0 (incoming) -> 1 (centre, ease sine.out) -> back toward 0.55 (exit, ease sine.in), so each cel 'lands' as it reaches centre. transform: scale(0.972 + 0.028*settle).
